## Summary

Full-Stack Developer (M.Tech, Gold Medalist) with 1+ year of experience building and securing production web and mobile systems. Sole developer on a live ride-hailing platform: a 406-route NestJS + MongoDB + Redis REST API, Next.js admin and fleet portals, and Flutter driver and customer apps, including the driver app's Google Play release and a paid Driver Pass subscription. Strong in REST API design, RBAC, payment gateway integration and measured performance and security work (4.8x faster rendering, 92.6% smaller payloads, OWASP Top 10 testing). Seeking a Full-Stack Software Engineer role.

## Experience

### Freelance (Contract) - Full-Stack Developer, Ride-Hailing Platform
Bangalore, India | Jul 2026 - Present

- Sole developer on five production applications on one backend: a 406-route NestJS/TypeScript REST API over MongoDB and Redis, Next.js admin and fleet-owner portals, and Flutter driver and customer apps for Android and iOS.
- Delivered the driver app's Google Play release (v1.1.13): rebuilt 20+ screens from Figma with GetX in 10 languages, fixed onboarding, ride-request queuing and accept-time eligibility checks, and made ride requests and cancellations data-only high priority FCM pushes that reach the app in the background.
- Built features end to end: Driver Pass subscriptions (Razorpay, Cashfree and Stripe orders activated by payment webhook, admin-managed plans), outstation dispatch, SOS, and an AI support assistant on the Claude API grounded in admin FAQs and the driver's account state.
- Integrated a new customer app and a second NestJS service into production: split routes between the customer API and the shared booking API, deployed it behind Apache reverse proxy and PM2, and verified login, booking, dispatch, push and share-tracking on the live stack.
- Measured performance pass: PDF rendering 2.94 s to 614 ms (4.8x) with a shared headless Chrome pool, admin bookings payload 10,503 to 779 bytes (92.6%) with gzip, deadlines on all 26 outbound HTTP calls, exchange-rate caching with last-known-good fallback, MongoDB pool tuning.
- Hardened API security and auditability: Helmet headers, rate limiting on OTP and login, JWT secret in environment config, an audit of all 406 endpoints closing unguarded routes, and a staff audit trail with before/after values and CSV export; fixed a cache bug that silently zeroed GST on fares.

### Ride-Hailing and Logistics Platform

Booking platform for rides, parcel delivery, intercity trips and rentals: a rider app, a driver app, and admin and fleet-owner web portals on one backend.

### Tea Stall Online Store
Personal project · 2026 | HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, Razorpay, Vercel

Redesign of a Bangalore tea retailer's website as a complete online store.
- 13-page responsive storefront: shop, product pages, cart, checkout, and catering and franchise enquiry forms.
- Razorpay checkout through four Node.js serverless functions, with cash on delivery as an option.
- Prices are recalculated on the server, so a tampered request is still charged correctly; payments are verified by HMAC-SHA256 signature, with a webhook as backup.
- A demo mode runs the whole checkout without payment keys.

### NeuroDigiScan - Brain Tumour Detection using Deep Learning
M.Tech project · 2022 - 2024 | Python, TensorFlow, Keras, OpenCV, Tkinter, SQLite

Detects brain tumours in MRI scans with a convolutional neural network.

- Desktop application (Tkinter + SQLite) for doctors: login, patient registration, MRI upload, detection result and a patient report.
